items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Alan, a champion. A champion all the way. Beautiful drummer. He did something I’ve never seen anybody ever do, at a clinic.

ctx.x: As long as we’re talking about the educating drummers, did you know Alan Dawson?

Alan, a champion. A champion all the way. Beautiful drummer. He did something I’ve never seen anybody ever do, at a clinic. Picks a set of brushes and goes through all the rudiments, playing brushes, while he’s playing a samba beat with the bass drum, da-dum, da-dum, da-dum, da-dum. That’s constant, and he goes through all the rolls, all the flams, ratamacues, playing brushes on the snare drum. That’s a work of art. That alone, right there, puts him in a class by himself. Great teacher and a marvelous player.…
